text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash, splash...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Off she goes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Along with the seagulls. Do you wanna
go see her
again?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...If I have time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after training is over...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Nakayama! Let's go look across the

shoreline!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Look across the shoreline?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, yeah. I remember now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Do you really have to ask? You should
know
already. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fact of the matter is that I don't know already.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you're curious, then come along. We're
just
gonna be hanging out anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You might even get to see an interesting
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess there's going to be a race
happening at
the beach? I decide to
follow them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We hop on a train...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then hike over a few mountains...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then we follow along a trail...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll take one soy sauce ramen! With extra
salt!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who said anything about that? Now go
on and
have a seat over there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice the table Nakayama Festa points
to is the
one closest to the restaurant's
TV.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now she has finally arrived in Hong
Kong! Will
she finally get her first G1
win? Let's follow along
on her journey!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yep. We've got our eyes on one of the
runners. She's called the "Silver
Collector" for how many
times she's just
barely missed getting first in G1s.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I forgot when we started, but Golshi and
I have
been betting on her races for a
while now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa and G...
text_block_list.text: That she'll win.
choice_data_list: Which one are you betting on?
Which one are you betting on?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aghhh! That's not fair! You said you'd let
me have
the one with the lower
probability!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm pretty sure I told you which one I think is least likely to occur...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What?! That's not fair! You're cheating!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You two get along just as well as
ever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! No way do I get along with a
dummy like
Nakayama! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's take this outside!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh! They're filming from the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Haha. And you sure love to sit at that
same table
each time, too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I know it seems self-indulgent, but you
might as
well enjoy yourself since you're
here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You wanna join in on the bet? It's not
much of a
"bet" if Golshi and I are on the
same side, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you're a big grown up. You in or
you in?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm betting on you winning.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here's your ramen! Eat up before the
noodles get
all soggy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all continue to watch the race as we
eat our
ramen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And all of us end up winning the bet.
